scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('dist/images',{recursive:true});['index.html','styles.css','script.js','robots.txt','sitemap.xml'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(f,path.join('dist',f)));fs.cpSync('images','dist/images',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('✓ Build complete: dist/ updated with images, robots.txt, sitemap.xml');"
